  • Touch controls

Product Description

This built-in electric hob brings two independent induction zones and touch controls together in a single flush-fit glass surface, sized for compact modular kitchens.

  • Two Independent Cooking Zones: Zones rated at 1800 W and 1500 W run at the same time on separate settings, so rice can boil on one while a curry simmers on the other. A two-zone induction hob suits compact modular kitchens where a wider cooktop would take over the entire counter.

  • Rated Power of 1800 W + 1500 W: Heat transfers straight into the vessel rather than escaping around the sides, so a litre of water boils faster than it would on gas. Everyday jobs like boiling milk, cooking dal, and roasting rotis all sit comfortably within this power range.

  • Boost Function up to 2000 W + 1500 W: Boost mode lifts the larger zone to 2000 W for rapid boiling and high-heat stir frying when the clock is against you. A double induction cooktop with boost brings water to a rolling boil in noticeably less time than a standard setting.

  • Nine Power Stages: Heat steps from a gentle simmer for kheer and milk up to full intensity for deep frying, with no guesswork about how far a knob has turned. A 2-burner induction hob with this many stages gives repeatable results, so the same setting behaves the same way every time.

  • Touch Controls with 99 Minute Timer: The flat panel has no knobs or crevices to collect oil and masala, and wipes clean in one pass. Set the timer and this touch control induction hob switches itself off once the time runs out, which helps with slow simmering and steaming.

  • Pan Sensor Technology: Each zone checks for compatible cookware before it begins heating and stops the moment a pan is lifted away. No energy is wasted warming an empty surface, and the glass never stays hot without a vessel on it.

  • Child Lock and Overheat Protection: Child lock freezes the panel so a stray press cannot change temperature or timer settings mid-cooking. Overheat protection monitors both zones and cuts power automatically if temperatures climb too high during long sessions.

  • Vitro Ceramic Glass with Flush Fit: The 520 x 290 mm glass surface wipes down after spills without scrubbing or scraping. A cut-out of 490 x 270 mm sets the hob level with the countertop, keeping the working surface flat and easy to clean around.
